facts.fact: 才刚过午后，塔姆辛带着宿醉却极想喝一杯（前一晚在 Curtyard 喝醉）。
facts.anchor: It was barely afternoon and despite my hangover I found myself desperately needing a drink.

facts.fact: 她伸手想摸叶子，认出气味是茴香与迷迭香便缩手；酒吧外墙一夜之间爬满香草绿植， rosemary 甚至爬过破招牌。
facts.anchor: Reaching out, I stopped as I identified the smells. Fennel. And rosemary?

facts.fact: 童年记忆转折：几年后父母的朋友 Graysons 夫妇离婚。
facts.anchor: Of course, that all changed a few years later when the Graysons divorced.

facts.fact: 母亲解释 Graysons 父母不再在一起，要她让两个女孩“分一点爸爸”。
facts.anchor: “Their parents aren’t together anymore,” my mum explained,

facts.fact: 同年夏天父亲买了黄风筝给那两个女孩——正是她从春天生日起一直想要的那只。
facts.anchor: Later that summer he bought them a yellow kite.

facts.fact: 酒吧中央一个女人单脚站立、用格纹围巾蒙眼，边喝啤酒边掷塑料圈套酒瓶。
facts.anchor: A woman stood on one bare foot with a tartan scarf wrapped around her eyes like a blindfold.

facts.fact: 女人扯下围巾后，左额弧线处有一道白疤——塔姆辛由此认出她。
facts.anchor: A white scar shone along the left-hand curve of her forehead.

facts.fact: 章末：那女人直视塔姆辛，说“很高兴见到你，邻居”，点明她就是隔壁邻居。
